summary.zh: 为重试、超时和瞬时故障设计容错
summary.en: Retry, back off and time out calls that can fail.

description.zh: 整理重试、指数退避、超时和容错装饰器的用法，让服务在瞬时故障下仍可用。给外部调用加保护、实现超时，或构建容错服务时使用。
description.en: Patterns for retries with exponential backoff, timeouts and fault-tolerant decorators that keep a service usable through transient failures. Use it when guarding outbound calls, adding timeouts or building resilient services.
